## MAIN IS RED AND I CAUSED IT: sweep (macos, full suite) broken by my merged change 2600

Branch-head run 33846424069 at 6b034b9f8224 concludes failure. All four pytest matrix cells pass
(including macos-latest py3.13). Two jobs fail: sweep (windows), which is continue-on-error and
cannot affect a conclusion, and sweep (macos, full suite), which has NO continue-on-error
(test.yml:370-373) -- so it is the cause of main's red.

  ERROR at teardown of test_provisioning_installs_then_builds_and_leaves_the_bundle...
  19243 passed, 72 skipped, 1 error in 2687.89s (0:44:47)

That test was added by 668523feffde -- change 2600, the 9a17 fix I drove. The job passed in all four
scheduled runs before it. This is my regression.

The test PASSES; the error is in TEARDOWN, in the autouse _no_repo_commits guard (conftest.py:774)
whose post-test 'git rev-parse HEAD' probe (tests/_isolation.py:39,68) fails or times out. Two
readings with different fixes: resource contention (that test provisions a real Node toolchain and is
the heaviest thing in the suite, in a 45-minute xdist run), or a leaked process/handle from
provisioning breaking the probe -- the latter would implicate 2600's fix more seriously. Filed
860b-28eb-10c0-4249 / uncovered-sonic-nightheron (p1) and dispatched, with diagnosis as the explicit
first deliverable rather than a fix.

BARRED THE TEMPTING SHORTCUT IN THE ACs: a bare macOS skip would make this green while hiding the
test. That is 'absence of execution reported as success' -- the fifth time today. Either make it
affordable or mark it not-run-on-macOS loudly with a recorded reason.

WHY IT ESCAPED PRE-MERGE -- the same structural gap, a fourth time: the Verified lane's macOS job runs
only the platform_compat marker selection, so the FULL macOS suite is schedule-only. The patchset lane
could not have caught this, exactly as it could not catch sweep (windows) or scanner-integration on
the changes that introduced them. Three separate defects tonight escaped because the lane that would
catch them does not run pre-merge. That is a coherent structural finding, not three coincidences, and
1035 (the make-lint proxy gap) is its local-tooling cousin.

Honest note on my own process: I verified 9a17's fix by checking that all four PYTEST cells went
green, and reported main healthy on that basis. I did not check the sweep tier, which is exactly
where my change's blast radius landed. Checking the cells my change was ABOUT, rather than the cells
my change could REACH, is a narrower verification than I claimed at the time.
